mapper.sql: sb2c.id, sb2c.code, sb2c.dict_platform as dictPlatform, sb2c.platform_code as platformCode, sb2c.shop_id as shopId, sb2c.approve_status as approveStatus, sb2c.pay_status as payStatus, sb2c.bill_status as billStatus, sb2c.invalid_status as invalidStatus, sb2c.amount as amount, sb2c.currency as currency, sb2c.exchange_rate as exchangeRate, sb2c.pay_time as payTime, sb2c.buyer_remark as buyerRemark, sb2c.remark as remark, sb2c.abnormal_type as abnormalType, sb2c.label_json as label, sb2c.is_intercept as isIntercept, sb2c.source_id as sourceId, sb2c.source_type as sourceType, sb2c.source_code as sourceCode, sb2c.is_match_order_rule as isMatchOrderRule, sb2c.is_match_logistics_rule as isMatchLogisticsRule, sb2cl.logistics_channel_name as logisticsChannelName, case when sb2cl.actual_shipping_cost = 0 then sb2cl.estimated_shipping_cost else sb2cl.actual_shipping_cost end as shippingCost, case when sb2cl.actual_shipping_cost = 0 then sb2cl.estimated_shipping_currency else sb2cl.actual_shipping_currency end as shippingCostCurrency, sb2cl.code as logisticsCode, sb2cl.logistics_channel_id as logisticsChannelId, sb2cl.logistics_channel_name as logisticsChannelName, sb2cr.customer_id as buyerId, sb2cr.name as buyerName, sb2cr.country_name as countryName, sb2c.create_time as createTime
mapper.select:
select
from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false inner join shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false
sb2c.is_deleted = false
and sb2c.code iLIKE concat('%',#{params.code}::text,'%')
and sb2c.platform_code iLIKE concat('%',#{params.platformCode}::text,'%')
and sb2c.invalid_status = #{params.invalidStatus}
and exists ( select id from so_b2c_detail where is_deleted = false and main_id = sb2c.id
and sb2cd.platform_sku_no iLIKE concat('%',#{params.platformSkuNo}::text,'%')
and sb2cd.platform_spu_no iLIKE concat('%',#{params.platformSpuNo}::text,'%')
and (sb2cd.label_json ~ 'U_TAXED' or sb2cd.label_json ~ 'I_TAXED')
)
and sb2c.dict_platform in
#{item}
and sb2c.id in ( select so_b2c_id from so_b2c_ref_category where is_deleted = false and category_id in
#{item}
)
and sb2c.shop_id in
#{item}
and si.dict_country_code in
#{item}
and sb2c.approve_status in
#{item}
and sb2c.bill_status in
#{item}
and sb2c.pay_status in
#{item}
and sb2c.abnormal_type in
#{item}
and (sb2c.label_json ~ 'RISK_CONTROL' or sb2c.label_json ~ 'IN_FROZEN' or sb2c.label_json ~ 'Unfulfillable')
and sb2c.label_json ~ 'AFN'
and sb2c.source_type = 'selfAdd'
and sb2c.is_intercept = true
and exists (select id from so_b2c_ref sbf where sbf.is_deleted = false and type = 'split' and sbf.target_id = sb2c.id)
and exists (select id from so_b2c_ref sbf where sbf.is_deleted = false and type = 'merge' and sbf.target_id = sb2c.id )
and (sb2cd.label_json ~ 'U_TAXED' or sb2cd.label_json ~ 'I_TAXED')
and sb2c.label_json ~ 'cainiaoInternationalWarehouse'
and sb2c.label_json ~ 'AE_PLUS'
and sb2c.label_json ~ 'HBA_UP_EXPRESS'
and sb2c.label_json ~ 'leadTimeTag#10'
order by sb2c.id desc

select sb2c.dict_platform as dictPlatform, sb2c.shop_id as shopId, sb2cr.name as buyerName, sb2c.currency as sourceCurrency, sb2cr.receiver_name as receiverName, sb2cr.first_address as firstAddress, sb2cr.second_address as secondAddress, sb2cr.full_address as fullAddress, sb2cd.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sb2cl.logistics_channel_id as logisticsChannelId from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_detail sb2cd on sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id and sb2cd.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false inner join shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false
sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sb2c.is_not_merge = false and (sb2c.approve_status = 'waitSubmit' or sb2c.approve_status = 'reject') and sb2c.label_json !~ 'AFN' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'U_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'I_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'cainiaoInternationalWarehouse' and sb2c.dict_platform != 'Shopee'
and sb2c.code iLIKE concat('%',#{params.code}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.buyerName}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.receiver_name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.receiverName}::text,'%')
and (sb2cr.first_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%') or sb2cr.second_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address},'%') or sb2cr.full_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%'))
and sb2c.dict_platform in
#{item}
and sb2c.shop_id in
#{item}
and si.dict_country_code in
#{item}
${params.permissionSql}
group by sb2c.dict_platform,sb2c.shop_id,sb2cr.name,sb2c.currency,sb2cr.receiver_name,sb2cr.first_address,sb2cr.second_address,sb2cr.full_address,sb2cd.warehouse_id,sb2cl.logistics_channel_id HAVING count(DISTINCT sb2c.id) > 1 order by sb2c.dict_platform,sb2cr.name,sb2c.shop_id

select count(distinct sb2c.id) from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_detail sb2cd on sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id and sb2cd.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false
sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sb2c.is_not_merge = false and (sb2c.approve_status = 'waitSubmit' or sb2c.approve_status = 'reject') and sb2c.label_json !~ 'AFN' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'U_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'I_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'cainiaoInternationalWarehouse' and sb2c.dict_platform != 'Shopee'
and sb2c.code iLIKE concat('%',#{params.code}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.buyerName}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.receiver_name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.receiverName}::text,'%')
and (sb2cr.first_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%') or sb2cr.second_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address},'%') or sb2cr.full_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%'))
and sb2c.dict_platform in
#{item}
and sb2c.shop_id in
#{item}
and sb2c.country_id in
#{item}
${params.permissionSql}
group by sb2c.dict_platform,sb2c.shop_id,sb2cr.name,sb2c.currency,sb2cr.receiver_name,sb2cr.first_address,sb2cr.second_address,sb2cr.full_address,sb2cd.warehouse_id,sb2cl.logistics_channel_id having count(distinct sb2c.id) > 1
